determinacy.why: What the Bank of Japan issues and how Tokyo shares are priced can be stored about the yen by name or about 'Japan's currency'. The first keeps the yen; the second moves them to the won. Functional and inverse come out the same either way.

assumes: The Bank of Japan issues the yen.
Shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange are priced in yen.
worlds.summary: Facts stored about the yen by name stay with the yen.

assumes: The Bank of Japan issues Japan's currency.
Shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange are priced in Japan's currency.
worlds.summary: Facts stored through 'Japan's currency' move to the won.

edit.statement: The currency of Japan is the South Korean won.
edit.subject: Japan
edit.original: The currency of Japan is the yen.
